plans.idea: Centered poster stack: the Pacewell logo crowns the canvas, the headline runs large across the middle on one or two balanced lines, and the badge and CTA sit together as one action row on the shared center axis.
Two-column split: the brand mark anchors the left column, and the right column is one left-aligned stack reading badge, then big headline, then CTA, so everything shares one edge.

Left-aligned editorial poster: a small logo in the top-left, a headline set very large across almost the full width, and the CTA with its rating badge beside it along the bottom-left, all hung from one left margin.
